title: Estate Services Terms for Releasing an Entrance Fee Agreement Refund to an Estate
content:
**Release.** An estate refund under an **Entrance Fee Agreement** is released by the estate's personal representative named in the letters on file, who signs the refund release; the refund is then paid in one payment by check to the estate in care of the address on file. An estate refund closes the agreement when it is paid.

**Conditions of release.**

An estate refund is not released until the agreement's ledger carries an amortization entry for every month of occupancy that began on or before the termination date.

An estate refund is released only after the agreement's ledger carries the tax letter for the tax year in which the agreement terminated.

Read against the agreement's ledger, both states must stand before the release is signed:

| Agreement's ledger | Release may be signed |
|---|---|
| An amortization entry for every month of occupancy that began on or before the termination date, and the tax letter for the tax year in which the agreement terminated | Yes |
| A month of occupancy that began on or before the termination date without an amortization entry | No |
| No tax letter for the tax year in which the agreement terminated | No |

## The release signature

The release is the customer's own action: the tool `release_estate_refund_4b5e42b1` is unlocked by the agent and handed over to the customer themselves, here the estate's personal representative, who signs electronically. Signing releases one refund payment for the amount given, paid by check to the estate in care of the mailing address on file and entered on the agreement's ledger dated today; the refundable balance falls by that amount and the agreement is closed with today's date. The tool computes nothing and checks nothing of its own.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `entrance_agreement_id` | Reference number of the Entrance Fee Agreement whose refund is released, read from the entrance fee agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `refund_amount` | The refund released to the estate | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, entered rounded half up to the cent |

**Receipt.** On success: `status` ("released"); `entrance_agreement_id`; `entrance_entry_id` (reference number of the refund payment entry); `refund_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `payment_reference` (the refund check number issued); `payment_method` ("check"); `refund_payee_type` ("estate"); `refundable_balance` (the balance after the payment, USD, 2 decimal places); `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
